nativeObservations: The left-to-right carrier-gas path is visibly separate from the orange stationary film on the inner column wall. A mixture is introduced before the column; the detector is downstream. The drawing is a schematic GC model, not a TLC solvent front or a claimed actual run.

The violet square is furthest downstream, red triangle intermediate, green circle furthest upstream. The main signal plots earliest violet, then red, then green; that qualitative retention order is coherent. The enlarged circle shows green interacting reversibly near the stationary film with a two-way arrow while red advances with the mobile flow.

Signal and reference have rightward time axes. The red reference peak aligns vertically with the middle red mixture peak, with a same-conditions label. No numerical retention times, substance identities, calibrated peak areas, quantity inference or unique-identity claim are printed.

Different schematic peak heights are not labelled as concentrations or amounts. Shapes/colours are representational species keys, not evidence that co-retention guarantees a unique real compound. The image remains orientation; its generic example does not override the supplied case data.

responsive360.finding: Carrier-gas cylinder, rightward flow, orange wall film, three distinct shape/colour markers, enlarged green interaction motif and three separated peaks remain identifiable. The red reference alignment remains visible. Same-conditions and tiny axis text are small; recognizing the motif does not require reading them, while the written goal/case retains the actual matched-condition requirement. No essential numerical table or tiny formula must be decoded.

responsive680.finding: Phase label, flow, green-wall interaction, symbols and signal/reference axes are clear. The complete16:9 image fits below the desktop448px height cap without cropping.

judgments.perspective: No acting person or person-facing notes require reversal. Detector and graphical time axes face the viewer coherently.
judgments.style: Rounded shapes, dark outlines, pale blue background and abstract coloured particles fit the existing Chemie image landscape. A method diagram is an appropriate depiction, without a photorealistic or sterile rendering change.

boundedPCompatibility.finding: Carrier gas/stationary interactions and matched qualitative reference support the two P expectations. No3.0/5.5min solution, A/B identity or observed instrument performance is supplied by the picture. Rf/front execution remains absent.

The picture gives no ethanol/ethyl-acetate/ethanoic-acid answer, conversion/purity judgment, quantity calibration or solution to the fresh co-elution case. Three generic symbolic peaks are an independent orientation example, not a replacement for the specified two-peak U data.

judgments.nonblockingBoundary: Keep the caption/alt and teaching use qualitative and reference-compatible. The image is no identity proof, amount calibration, actual performance observation or full P answer.

nativeObservations: Three visibly distinct coloured evidence motifs are shown: vial/chromatogram for analysis, folder/process diagram/blank checklist for documentation, and a statute-symbol book for legal framework. Arrows bring them to a magnified generic package/tablets.

The large question mark and open-questions label explicitly leave the evidential judgment open. There is no release seal, ticked pass checklist, official authorisation certificate, real brand, medicine-use instruction, patient/treatment/clinical-effect claim or section-specific legal advice.

The chromatographic trace is symbolic and uncalibrated, not a labelled successful specification test. The documentation icon does not certify actual manufacturing practice. The law book represents a framework, not individual-case approval. The three sources therefore do not visually assert that the pictured generic product is released or safe to use.

responsive360.finding: The three large category headings and their distinct chart/folder/statute motifs are recognizable; arrows, magnified package/tablets and open question remain clear. Small form lines and peak ticks are decorative examples, not text or numbers necessary for an evidential decision.

responsive680.finding: All headings, documentation motif, graph and open question are legible, with no crowded fine-print evidence.16:9 fits the desktop limit without cropping.

judgments.perspective: No people are depicted. Pages/book/graph face the viewer; no person-oriented experimental diagram is reversed.
judgments.style: Friendly warm work surface, rounded dark outlines, simplified objects and clear coloured panels fit the cartoon/abstract existing Chemie style. No photo-real product redesign.

boundedPCompatibility.finding: The image separates the evidence categories and keeps an open question; it supplies no verdict on fictional batchX, no missing-record answer, analytical detection limits, real release or individual legal conclusion.

No label claiming authorisation, clean-blank verdict or resolved batch-attribution answer is shown. The generic icons do not replace the case-specific fresh blank/traceability reasoning. The statutory purpose remains visibly only a framework.

judgments.nonblockingBoundary: The selected RP elective/source/course and whole P/D gates remain separate. The picture cannot establish actual GMP, clinical efficacy, medicine authorisation or a real batch release.
